description: Ministry of Agriculture - Notify the order to rescind that published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1937/35 of 23.10.2015 on the advice of the Pesticides Technical & Advisory Committee
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under Section 11 of the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980, which involves the rescission of a previous regulatory order. It pertains to the legal and regulatory framework for pesticide control, falling squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) that cover statutory instruments, regulatory actions, and legal notices.
